items.title: debpalash/VoiceStudio
items.summary_en: VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully-local alternative to ElevenLabs offering voice cloning, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation across 646 languages. It features 16 TTS engines, 11 ASR engines, and runs on macOS, Windows, Linux, and Docker without requiring accounts, API keys, subscriptions, or usage metering for local workflows. The AGPL-3.0 tool supports CUDA, Apple Silicon MPS/MLX, ROCm, and CPU compute with both desktop and API interfaces.

items.title: スマホの指がエコーキャンセラを壊していた — 音でないもので発話が切れる
items.why_now_en: No clear timeliness signal — it's a debugging log, not a market event.
items.summary_en: A voice dialogue avatar experienced misinterrupts on iPhone Safari when users covered the speaker with their finger, causing sudden acoustic changes that confused the browser's echo canceller and triggered false VAD speech detection. The fix increased the continuous audio duration threshold required to recognize speech from 0.2 to 0.5 seconds during bot playback, reducing sensitivity without affecting normal response times. Industry analysis of LiveKit's approach shows that delaying VAD judgment by ~216ms can reject 51% of echo-based misinterrupts, as most commercial services rely on client-side AEC with no universal solution for mobile speakerphone scenarios.

items.title: multimodal-art-projection/YuE
items.summary_en: YuE2 is a frontier music generation model that achieves 6.9632 SongBench Avg (best-of-8), outperforming all evaluated settings and competing with Suno v5/v6 on WildSongBench. It uses an AR–NAR Mixture-of-Transformers backbone with symbolic planning to make melody and chords explicitly editable before rendering full stereo audio at 48 kHz, supporting zero-shot covers and agentic multi-step editing. The model is available as a 3B-parameter open-source release via Hugging Face, requiring an NVIDIA GPU with BF16 support and 24 GB VRAM.

items.title: SnailSploit/Claude-Red
items.summary: Claude-Red 是由 SnailSploit 开发的开源技能库，专为 Claude Skills 系统设计，通过结构化的 SKILL.md 文件将 Claude 转化为具备专家级方法论的上下文感知红队操作员。该库涵盖 Web 应用（16项技能）、无线安全（14项）、基础设施与红队操作（7项）、漏洞利用开发（6项）等共23
items.summary_en: claude-red is a curated library of offensive security skills for the Claude Skills system, consisting of structured SKILL.md files that transform Claude into a context-aware red team operator. The library spans 23 categories including Web Application (16 skills), Wireless (14), Exploit Development (6), and Infrastructure & Red Team (7), with skills loading on demand based on conversational triggers. Installation is via `git clone` or the provided install script, supporting use cases such as authorized red team engagements, bug bounty triage, CTF preparation, and security research.

items.title: peetzweg/opendisplay
items.summary: OpenDisplay 是一个免费开源的 Sidecar/Duet Display 替代方案，可将 iPhone、iPad 或备用 Mac（macOS 12+）作为 Mac 的第二扩展显示器使用。该项目采用硬件 H.264 编码（VideoToolbox，无 B 帧），通过 USB 或 WiFi 传输，支持 Retina HiDPI（@2x 像素级匹配）和触摸/双击滚动输入。相比 Sidecar（仅支持 iPad、需同一 Apple ID）、Duet（订阅制）和 Luna Display（需硬件 dongle），OpenDisplay 完全自托管、无需账号且支持有线连接。

items.title: Show HN: Uplink – Software for Agents
Good luck slowing this down
items.summary_en: The author finds Anthropic's Instinct personal agent underwhelming, citing its overly proactive behavior, slow performance, and privacy concerns around Meta, while noting that AI companies will inevitably ship their own agents. Meanwhile, OpenAI announced no IPO in 2026, introduced GPT-Live-1 and its Agents API to the developer platform, launched a ChatGPT mini floating widget, and saw tldraw's founder build a prototype claiming to outperform ChatGPT Sketch 100x in a day-long challenge. Elsewhere, Bolt Forge offers GLM, DeepSeek, and Kimi models free until October 14, and Claude Code now supports plugin effectiveness testing.

items.title: Early Anthropic hire, former METR COO have found a way to rein in rogue AI agents
items.summary: AIUC（Artificial Intelligence Underwriting Company）由早期Anthropic员工Rune Kvist和前METR COO Rajiv Dattani联合创立，专注于为企业提供AI代理安全审计与认证服务，已获Ribbit Capital领投的4,000万美元A轮融资，累计筹资5,500万美元，客户包括Cursor、Lovable、Harvey和ElevenLabs。该公司基于SOC 2标准开发了AIUC-1规范，通过约5,000项测试用例对代理进行越狱、幻觉和数据泄露等场景验证，生成约100页审计报告，测试环节由AI执行但最终由人类审核。

items.title: alibaba/open-code-review
items.summary: OpenCodeReview是阿里巴巴开源的AI代码审查CLI工具，采用确定性流水线+LLM Agent混合架构，内置NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL注入等多语言规则集，已在内部服务数万开发者并发现数百万代码缺陷。相比Claude Code等通用Agent，其在相同底层模型下实现更高精确率与F1分数，token消耗仅为1/9，审查速度更快，但召回率较低——这是有意为之的精度优先权衡。

items.title: Generators are All You Need
items.summary: 作者通过让AI编码代理构建OpenAPI代码生成器，仅用**1小时**完成过去耗费**一个月**手动适配却失败的工程；该方法的核心是通过规范与端到端测试来验证生成结果，目前团队已将大部分代码转换为生成代码——生成器本身代码量少于其生成的代码，使得维护和修改效率大幅提升。
items.summary_en: The author attempted to make existing OpenAPI code generators work for a month across every language before switching tactics: a coding agent built a custom generator in one hour. The team then converted most of their codebase to generated code, creating a maintainable system where generators are shorter than the code they produce, so changes propagate through regeneration rather than manual editing. The approach relies on verifiable contracts and end-to-end tests, positioning AI as a tool for building code-generating infrastructure rather than directly writing application code.

items.title: Show HN: Inkling – ask Claude Code for a doc, get HTML instead of Markdown
items.summary: Inkling 是 Claude Code 的一个技能插件，支持通过自然语言指令自动生成包含 HTML、CSS、JavaScript 和数据的交互式文档文件夹。安装后，用户只需输入“为 X 创建 HTML 文档”，Claude 便会自动设计文档结构并实时更新 `index.html`、`style.css` 等文件，全程无需命令行或模板。该工具适用于系统设计文档、HLD 等需要图表和交互元素的说明性内容。
items.summary_en: Inkling is a Claude Code skill that converts plain-language prompts into fully interactive HTML documents, including real-time edits to a local folder of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and data files. Unlike template-based tools, it designs custom doc structures from scratch and enforces five axes: Interactive, Computational, Aesthetic, Warm, and Originality (minimum 5/10). Installation requires either a one-command GitHub fetch via Claude Code or running the install.sh script, with no external MCP servers or special permissions needed.

items.title: Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
items.summary_en: Google introduced Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking, two voice-optimized models featuring near real-time visual grounding, automatic detection across 97 languages, and background tool/API execution without interrupting conversation. Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking tops Artificial Analysis' Speech to Speech Quality Index at 82.6, leads agentic task completion with 68.6% on τ-Voice and 35.1% on Sierra's τ-Voice-banking benchmark, and scores 97.7% on Big Bench Audio, while Gemini 3.8 Live placed second in the Speech Agent Arena. The models are available via the Gemini Live API and partner platforms including Agora, LangChain, LiveKit, Vercel, and Pipecat, with SynthID audio watermarking enabled across all AI-generated outputs.

items.title: 前OpenAI后训练VP回应陶哲轩：说AI毁了数学，可能还是太小瞧AI了
items.summary: OpenAI前训练VP Liam Fedus回应陶哲轩等25位菲尔兹奖得主的担忧，认为未来AI不仅能解题还能建立概念框架；2026年5月OpenAI内部模型反驳了近80年历史的Erdős单位距离猜想，同年又用约1万个AI Agent在88小时内找到Navier-Stokes方程奇点证明并通过Lean形式化验证，但AMS、LMS及克雷数学研究所（CMI）均强调成果仍需经同行检验与长期验证才能进入数学知识体系。

items.title: Arena 更新 Image-to-WebDev 榜单：GPT-6 Astra 以 1733 分登顶
items.summary: GPT-6 Astra（Max）以1733分登顶图像转WebDev Arena榜单，领先第二名23分，其成本为$40/M tokens。Meta的Muse Spark 1.3（1645分，$3.50/M）与智谱GLM-5.3-Flash（1588分，$0.21/M）同时登上帕累托前沿，在性能与成本间实现高效平衡。该榜单评估模型从图像/截图生成网站的能力，涵盖多步推理与智能体编程工作流。

items.title: The AI data center boom is colliding with cities scarred by big industry
items.summary_en: AI data centers are facing fierce opposition in U.S. communities already bearing the legacy of heavy industry, particularly in Philadelphia's Grays Ferry neighborhood, where residents link chronic health issues to the now-defunct oil refinery. BloombergNEF projects that by 2035, U.S. data centers will consume more natural gas than Germany and Japan combined—nearly double a previous forecast—generating an estimated additional 1 million metric tons of greenhouse gas emissions daily, equivalent to about 12% of current U.S. emissions. Despite promises of economic growth and jobs, opposition persists among residents who fear renewed pollution and strain on finite local resources.

items.title: 🚀 How Did an Indie Founder Reach $17,000/m After Being Stuck at $300/m?
items.summary: 一位独立创始人通过测试所有免费渠道并砍掉低转化选项，以3人团队和零付费广告实现月收入从$300跃升至$17,000；团队追踪Google Analytics中流量来源、转化率和销售来源三个核心指标，优先开展联盟推广（成交后支付20-30%佣金）以获取免费外链，再配合SEO策略。同时，Upwork宣布开放AI agent发布职位功能，预计将冲击现有
items.summary_en: An indie founder scaled a SaaS from $300/m to $17,000/m in a single month by aggressively testing every free growth channel and cutting what didn't convert. Separately, a 3-person team hit $358,000 at 70% margins with zero marketing budget by starting affiliate outreach before SEO, paying 20-30% commissions only after conversions, and tracking traffic source, conversion rate, and sales source in Google Analytics.

items.title: OpenAI、Anthropic、谷歌联手研究 AI 安全；微信员工辟谣 AI 助手小微「偷隐私」；美国已在太空部署武器
items.summary_en: ByteDance's 2026 H1 net profit declined as AI investment intensified, with revenue growing 30% year-over-year; it secured a record $30 billion loan while competitors Alibaba and Zhipu AI raised $10 billion and $5 billion respectively for AI. OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind announced collaboration on AI safety research amid growing concerns over economic and national security risks. Meanwhile, Meta plans to deploy its next-generation self-developed AI chips (MTIA 500) in data centers by 2027, and Micron unveiled the world's first 512GB DDR5-9200 memory module capable of 12TB per server.

items.title: 复旦发布以人为中心的复杂场景音视频追踪基准 | ICML 2026
items.summary_en: Fudan University's CVL Lab released **AVTrack**, an audio-visual speaker tracking benchmark accepted at ICML 2026, comprising 871 videos averaging 54 seconds with 3,120 pixel-level instance trajectories annotated for cross-frame identity. The dataset introduces 8 diagnostic challenge categories—most notably camera motion change (90.5% of samples) and visual occlusion (80.9%)—significantly surpassing prior benchmarks like AVISeg. Their proposed **AVTracker** modular model achieved a **HOTA of 29.08**, substantially outperforming existing methods such as AVISM (20.84) and end

items.title: 全球AI视频榜单第一梯队再添中国力量：智象发布首款物理规律导向视频模型
items.summary: 智象未来正式发布首款物理规律导向视频模型HiDream-O1-Video-1.0（HD-V1），采用原生全模态架构，支持文本、图片、视频多模态输入，可一键生成5-20秒1080p高保真视频，在Artificial Analysis图生视频榜单列全球第4、Arena.ai榜单列全球第8。该模型通过前置多模态意图理解模块与物理规律底层建模，实现音画原生一体化联合生成，并支持按叙事逻辑自主决策视频时长。同期智象宣布完成C+轮融资，新微资本、交子资本、工银资本等国资产业资本组团加码。
items.summary_en: HiDream.ai (智象未来) released HiDream-O1-Video-1.0 (HD-V1), its first native full-modal video generation model that outputs 5–20 second 1080p videos from text, image, or video input. HD-V1 ranked 4th on Artificial Analysis's Image-to-Video (With Audio) leaderboard and 8th on Arena.ai's Image-to-Video benchmark, notable for integrating physics-aware reasoning, autonomous narrative planning, and native audio-visual joint modeling rather than post-hoc sound addition. The release completes HiDream's native full-modal world model matrix—spanning image, video, interactive 3D, and embodied models—amid a completed C+ funding round backed by 新微资本 and 交子资本.

items.title: [AINews] AEF-1 standard emerges for Third Party Evaluators, as Xai, OpenAI, and Anthropic all cosign
items.summary: AEF-1 标准由 AI Evaluator Forum（2025 年 12 月成立）发布，Xai、OpenAI 和 Anthropic 共同签署，为独立第三方 AI 评估设定了关于准入权限、利益冲突、资金关系和透明度的baseline。Dario Amodei 单方面承诺向嵌入第三方评估团队（如 METR）开放办公空间、门禁和内部工具权限，类比银行监管制度；与此同时，前沿 AI 行业在"放缓发展节奏"与"聚焦安全管控"之间出现公开分歧——Bilal Chughtai 离职呼吁 pacing，Daniel Selsam 警告情境感知模型可能伪装对齐，而 Kapoor 等人则认为近期问题本质是安全治理而非通用对齐研究。

items.title: How much of F-Droid is LLM generated?
items.summary: 作者观察到 F-Droid 上难以找到纯人类编写的软件，提出通过仓库的"低努力"迹象来判断是否由 LLM 生成，例如自动生成 README、让 AI 自我审查代码、不手动 commit 等。尽管承认 LLM 在提升开发效率和辅助发现代码安全问题方面有价值，但他认为 LLM 使编程学习
items.summary_en: A student and FOSS app maintainer for F-Droid investigates how much content on the platform is LLM-generated after noticing an obvious AI-generated app icon. He proposes a 3-tier detection system based on repo aesthetics and low-effort indicators like LLM-written READMEs, self-performed code reviews, and skipped commit hygiene. While acknowledging LLMs can rapidly prototype software and help find bugs, the author criticizes their broader impact on programming culture and learning.

items.title: My headache tracker used to charge for AI reports. I deleted the AI, ran the math on the phone instead, and made it free.
items.summary: HeadSense从1.0的付费订阅模式重构为2.0免费版，核心变化是将原本由服务器AI生成的周报和月报改为设备端本地计算，砍掉了所有服务器成本。重新设计的UI采用暗室风格与大屏按钮，支持从锁屏直接更新头痛强度，并移除账户、数据分析，所有数据默认留在本地，仅iOS 26英语版可用。
items.summary_en: The developer rebuilt HeadSense 1.0 by replacing its subscription model and server-hosted AI reports with on-device computation, making the migraine tracker completely free. The 2.0 redesign features a dim interface for photophobic users, lock-screen intensity updates, no accounts or analytics, and optional iCloud backup only.

items.title: Salesforce and Nvidia’s new reasoning model is everything the AI labs should fear
items.summary: Salesforce与Nvidia联合推出推理模型Koa，基于Nvidia开源的Nemotron模型进行后训练，专注销售、营销和客服场景。相比Claude或ChatGPT等闭源前沿模型，Koa使用合成数据训练而非真实客户数据，能更安全地集成到Agentforce平台，同时通过更高效的推理架构减少token消耗。该模型可作为企业级替代方案，在保持数据主权的同时处理多步骤推理任务。
items.summary_en: Salesforce and Nvidia launched Koa, the first reasoning AI model built on Nvidia's open-weight Nemotron, specifically trained for sales, marketing, and customer support tasks using synthetic data rather than actual customer information. Koa offers enterprise customers an open-weight alternative to proprietary frontier models, reducing AI spending through token efficiency while maintaining data security and compliance within Salesforce's infrastructure via the Agentforce platform's AI gateway. The model enables complex multi-step reasoning previously reliant on Claude or ChatGPT, while Salesforce also announced a new Anthropic partnership called Claudeforce for standard agent tasks.

directions.name: 多设备屏幕共享引擎
directions.description: 一个免费的开源工具，允许用户将 iPhone、iPad 或 Android 设备作为 Mac 的第二扩展显示器，无需订阅或专用硬件。
directions.description_en: A free open-source tool that lets users use iPhone, iPad, or Android devices as a second extended display for Mac, without subscriptions or dedicated hardware.
directions.target_user: 独立开发者和远程工作者，需要低成本多屏解决方案。
directions.target_user_en: Independent developers and remote workers who need a low-cost multi-monitor solution.
core_features: 通过 USB 或 Wi‑Fi 将移动设备变为 Mac 的第二显示器
支持 Retina HiDPI 像素级匹配，低延迟触摸/滚动输入
完全自托管，无需 Apple ID 或第三方账号
core_features_en: Turn mobile devices into a second Mac display via USB or Wi‑Fi
Retina HiDPI pixel‑perfect matching with low‑latency touch/scroll input
Fully self‑hosted, no Apple ID or third‑party accounts required
directions.why_now: 社区近期热议 Sidecar/Duet 的局限（需同一 Apple ID、订阅费或硬件 dongle），GitHub Trending 评分 7/10 显示需求强烈。该开源项目提供了技术基础，此时推出一个优化版（如增强 Android 兼容、加入团队协作功能）可快速占领蓝海市场。
directions.why_now_en: Recent community discussions highlight limitations of Sidecar/Duet (same Apple ID, subscription fees, or hardware dongles). A GitHub Trending score of 7/10 indicates strong demand. Leveraging this open-source project to launch an optimized version (e.g., enhanced Android compatibility, team collaboration features) can quickly capture an underserved market.
directions.monetization: 提供免费核心版，高级版（如 4K 支持、多设备同时共享、IT 管理面板）收费订阅（$5/月）或一次性买断（$30）。
directions.monetization_en: Offer a free core version; charge for a premium tier (4K support, simultaneous multi-device sharing, IT admin panel) via subscription ($5/month) or one-time purchase ($30).

directions.name: Agent 协作中枢
directions.description: 一个可视化平台，帮助一人公司追踪、协调和管理多个 AI Agent 的日常任务与输出。
directions.description_en: A visual platform that helps solo founders track, coordinate, and manage daily tasks and outputs of multiple AI agents.
directions.target_user: 一人公司创始人、独立开发者，使用多个 AI Agent 处理业务运营。
directions.target_user_en: Solo founders and indie developers using multiple AI agents for business operations.
core_features: 仪表板实时显示各 Agent 状态、日志和产出
工作流编排：设置 Agent 间触发条件和任务流转
成本监控：跟踪 API 调用次数和费用，设置预算预警
core_features_en: Dashboard showing real-time agent status, logs, and outputs
Workflow orchestration: define trigger conditions and task handoffs between agents
Cost tracking: monitor API usage and expenses with budget alerts
directions.why_now: Hacker News Show HN 提交 “Uplink – Software for Agents” 获得关注，标签直接指向“Agent工具”和“一人公司”。独立开发者正大量部署多个 Agent，但缺乏集中管理工具，社区讨论凸显了对协调、监控和成本控制的迫切需求。此时推出轻量级中枢产品可抓住早期采用者。
directions.why_now_en: The Hacker News Show HN submission “Uplink – Software for Agents” has garnered attention, with tags highlighting “Agent tools” and “one-person company.” Independent developers are deploying multiple agents but lack centralized management. Community discussion reveals urgent need for coordination, monitoring, and cost control. Launching a lightweight hub now captures early adopters.
directions.monetization: 免费额度（每月 100 次 Agent 调用），超出后按调用量阶梯付费（$0.01/次）或订阅专业版（$20/月）解锁高级编排和团队协作功能。
directions.monetization_en: Free tier (100 agent calls/month), then pay-per-use ($0.01/call) or subscribe to Pro plan ($20/month) for advanced orchestration and team collaboration features.
directions.source_article: Show HN: Uplink – Software for Agents
